entries.name: orca
entries.description: Orca lets you run a fleet of coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 5,616 star（日均约 802，相对存量增速 4.4%），累计 127,488 star、8,084 fork。窗口内被 fork 417 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，468 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 5,616 stars over the last 7 days (~802/day, 4.4% of its base), now at 127,488 stars and 8,084 forks. 417 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 468 contributors.

intro.zh: Orca 是一款 AI 代理编程工具，帮助你在本地或云端同时运行多个编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）。它提供聊天、终端、浏览器和 CLI 一体化体验，让团队可以并行完成大型任务。
intro.en: Orca is an AI agent orchestrator that lets you run multiple coding agents—Claude Code, Codex, and more—in parallel, whether on your laptop or the cloud. It unifies chat, terminal, browser, and CLI so teams can split big tasks across isolated worktrees and keep everything running even when your laptop sleeps.

cardLine.zh: 一站式 AI 编程代理管理，支持聊天、终端、浏览器与 CLI。
cardLine.en: All-in-one AI coding agent manager with chat, terminal, browser, and CLI support.

highlights.zh: 在聊天界面或原始 CLI 里运行任何代理，保持上下文不丢失。
highlights.en: Run any agent in chat UI or raw CLI while preserving conversation context.

highlights.zh: 任务拆分后，自动在独立工作树中启动工作代理并汇总结果。
highlights.en: Split tasks and automatically start worker agents in separate worktrees, then bring results back.

highlights.zh: 支持远程服务器、SSH 主机或云 VM，让代理在你离线时继续工作。
highlights.en: Run on remote servers, SSH hosts, or cloud VMs so agents keep working when you’re offline.

highlights.zh: 移动端应用可随时收到代理提醒，回复聊天并保持进度。
highlights.en: Mobile app alerts you when an agent needs input, letting you continue work from any device.

cons.zh: 开放 issue 8,550 个，相对 star 规模偏高
cons.en: 8,550 open issues — high relative to its star count

fitFor.zh: 探索多智能体协作、角色分工与复杂流水线编排的架构师
fitFor.en: Architects exploring multi-agent collaboration, role assignments, and pipeline orchestration

fitFor.zh: 希望借助 AI 辅助编程、自动化代码审查或工程提效的开发团队
fitFor.en: Development teams implementing AI coding assistants, automated code review, or dev productivity

fitFor.en: Developers embedding agent capabilities into their own product

entries.quickstart:
# 摘自 stablyai/orca 的 README
# macOS (Homebrew)
# Always use the full name; bare `orca` is an unrelated Plotly cask.
brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Upgrade an existing install
brew upgrade --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Release candidates (conflicts with the stable cask; uninstall it first)
brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca@rc

# Arch Linux (AUR) — or stably-orca-git to build from source
yay -S stably-orca-bin

intro.zh: Taste Skill 是一款给编码代理加“味道”的插件，让它们能像 Figma 或 x.ai 那样生成专业公司网站，而不是普通的落地页。

cardLine.zh: 让 AI 代理生成专业公司网站，包含真实照片、品牌图标和微交互。

highlights.en: Validate page output in a real browser with a checker to enforce design rules.

entries.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.

why.en: Gained 3,525 stars over the last 7 days (~504/day, 2.4% of its base), now at 149,413 stars and 14,363 forks. 446 new forks in the window; last push 1 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 391 contributors.

intro.zh: Graphify 能把任何代码库、文档、SQL 模式、配置和 PDF 转化为可查询的知识图谱。只需一条命令，AI 代理就能在图谱上提问，而不是在文件里搜索。
intro.en: Graphify turns any codebase, docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs into a queryable knowledge graph. Just one command lets your AI agent ask questions on the graph instead of grepping files.

cardLine.zh: 把代码库变成可查询的知识图谱，AI 代理直接在图谱上提问。
cardLine.en: Turn your codebase into a queryable knowledge graph for AI agents.

highlights.zh: 使用 tree-sitter 解析 AST，完全本地化，数据不离机。

highlights.zh: 每条边都有“EXTRACTED”或“INFERRED”标签，清晰可追溯。
highlights.en: Each edge is tagged EXTRACTED or INFERRED for clear traceability.

highlights.zh: 支持多种 AI 助手（Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini CLI 等），一次安装即可。
highlights.en: Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and more—install once.

highlights.zh: 云版 Graphify Cloud 提供持续运行的图谱，集成 Sentry、Jira 等。

entries.name: OmniRoute
entries.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 375 providers (150+ free), 1,400+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by 900+ contributors

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 1,862 star（日均约 266，相对存量增速 2.1%），累计 88,282 star、13,565 fork。窗口内被 fork 476 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，432 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 1,862 stars over the last 7 days (~266/day, 2.1% of its base), now at 88,282 stars and 13,565 forks. 476 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 432 contributors.

intro.zh: OmniRoute 是一款免费的 AI 网关，支持 375 个模型供应商（150+ 免费），一次调用即可访问 Kimi、Claude、GPT、Gemini 等多种大模型。开发者只需配置自己的 API 账号，系统会自动管理配额、切换和压缩，省时省力。
intro.en: OmniRoute is a free AI gateway that lets you access 375 model providers (150+ free tiers) with a single endpoint. Developers just plug in their own API keys, and OmniRoute handles quota, fallback, and token compression automatically, saving time and effort.

cardLine.zh: 一站式 AI 网关，支持 375+ 模型，自动管理配额与压缩。
cardLine.en: One‑stop AI gateway for 375+ models with automatic quota handling and token compression.

highlights.zh: 支持 375+ 模型，覆盖 Kimi、Claude、GPT、Gemini 等主流大模型。
highlights.en: Supports 375+ models, including Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, and more.

highlights.zh: 自动配额感知调度，按需切换免费与付费模型，避免超限。
highlights.en: Quota‑aware scheduling automatically switches between free and paid tiers to avoid limits.

highlights.zh: RTK+Caveman 压缩技术可节省 15-95% token，降低成本。
highlights.en: RTK+Caveman compression saves 15‑95% of tokens, cutting costs.

highlights.zh: 提供桌面/PWA 版本，支持离线使用与多平台部署。
highlights.en: Desktop/PWA support enables offline use and multi‑platform deployment.

fitFor.zh: 希望借助 AI 辅助编程、自动化代码审查或工程提效的开发团队
fitFor.en: Development teams implementing AI coding assistants, automated code review, or dev productivity

fitFor.zh: 偏好极简终端体验、需要嵌入命令行自动化脚本的极客开发者
fitFor.en: Geek developers preferring terminal interfaces and lightweight CLI workflow automation
